usage: The word '海豚' is a noun used to refer to the animal 'dolphin'.
You can use '海豚' as the subject of a sentence. For Example:  海豚好聰明 (Dolphins are very smart).
It can also be used as the object after a verb. For Example:  我見過海豚 (I have seen a dolphin).
'海豚' can be combined with measure words like '隻' to count dolphins, e.g., 一隻海豚 (one dolphin).
It can be used in plural form without change, just like most Cantonese nouns.
